subject: maths
title: Exponentials, Logarithms and Transformations
welcome_lead: Stretch, shift and reflect: master function transformations and e^x.
meta_desc: Maths adventure on exponential, logarithm, modulus functions and transformations.
final_note: Transformations: outside affects y, inside affects x in reverse!

concepts.def: f(x) = e^x grows continuously with base e.
|x| = x if x ≥ 0, else -x; always non-negative.
f(x) + k shifts graph up by k units.
f(x/a) stretches horizontally by factor a.
-f(x) flips across x-axis; f(-x) across y-axis.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Solve e^(2x) = 7.

Take ln: 2x = ln(7), so x = ln(7)/2 ≈ 0.973.

Describe y = 2f(x - 3) + 1 from y = f(x).

Shift right 3, stretch vertically by 2, shift up 1.

Solve |x - 4| = 5.

x - 4 = 5 or x - 4 = -5, giving x = 9 or x = -1.

mcqs.q: Is the result of 6 / 0.5 larger or smaller than 6?
options: Larger — dividing by a number less than 1 gives a bigger result (6 / 0.5 = 12).
Smaller, because division always makes numbers smaller.
Equal to 6, because 0.5 is half and so cancels out.
(3x + 3)(2x + 3), by trying to factorise as a quadratic.
